opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants

amount.raw: New Projects and Commissions: max £20,000; Acquisitions and Collections: max £20,000; Conferences, Lectures and Publications: max £5,000; Long-Term Research: max £20,000; Research and Travel: max £2,500

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK and international non-profit organisations (must be established and operating as non-profit for at least 12 months) for all categories except Research and Travel; individual sculpture historians, academics and conservators researching and publishing on sculpture conservation, production, history and/or interpretation for the Research and Travel category. Individuals independently wishing to create/inform/develop their own practice are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Grants supporting the growth and development of sculpture across historical, modern and contemporary registers, and research that expands appreciation of sculpture. Categories include exhibitions, exhibition catalogues, commissions, conferences, research, non-commercial publications, acquisitions, conservation, cataloguing and display, plus Research and Travel grants for individuals. Applications considered four times per year; the Autumn round is currently open.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships (Visiting Research, Artist Research, Senior Fellowships)

amount.raw: Expenses allocation for travel and subsistence: UK up to £600; Europe up to £700; Rest of world up to £1,000. Accommodation in Leeds or Hertfordshire provided for the duration of the fellowship.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Academics or curators working on historic and contemporary sculpture (Visiting Research Fellowships); researchers whose interests lie in Henry Moore (Studios & Gardens fellowships); artists developing their practice through research (Artist Research Fellowships); established scholars for six-week Senior Fellowships. Applications from all sections of the community welcome.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships enabling artists and researchers to spend a month using the Henry Moore Institute's facilities in Leeds or Henry Moore Studios & Gardens in Hertfordshire, including accommodation, travel and subsistence expenses. Applications are currently closed for 2026/27; the next round opens in spring 2027.
